# Information Retrieval & Entity Modeling Institute

> Information Gain Patents, Entity Disambiguation, and Neural Retrieval

## Published Research
- [Algorithmic Information Gain and Entity Modeling: Modern Search Indexation for AI Coding Agents](algorithmic-information-gain-entity-modeling-ai-agents.html): Analyzing Google Information Gain patent algorithms and how structured entity disambiguation drives superior search indexing in modern developer workflows.
- [Quantifying Information Gain in Technical Documentation](quantifying-information-gain-technical-documentation.html): Mathematical models for measuring content novelty against search corpus clusters.
- [Entity-Attribute-Value Modeling in Semantic SEO](entity-attribute-value-modeling-semantic-seo.html): Constructing robust knowledge graphs to boost search crawler comprehension.
